newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippines' Ramos health okay, says doctor.
newsitem.headline: Philippines' Ramos health okay, says doctor.

text.p: Philippine president Fidel Ramos received a clean bill of health on Tuesday after his latest medical check-up, his physician said.
Raul Fores, director of the Makati Medical Centre, said Ramos was in better condition than the average 69-year old Filipino.
Ramos' health has been a source of concern for local financial markets after he underwent an operation last December to remove an arterial clot in his neck.
"So far, all the tests that we have the results of, show no problem," said Fores, who had performed December's operation.
His latest check-up, which included blood, x-ray and ultrasound examinations, precedes a 10-day state visit to Central America scheduled for next week.
"I feel very good," Ramos told reporters after the check-up. "I'm ready to go."
